scope: Bounded English numeric/date equivalence for ASR comparison; original English TTS body unchanged

tests.command: HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 MODELSCOPE_OFFLINE=1 GRADIO_ANALYTICS_ENABLED=False OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 KMP_USE_SHM=0 ./venv_audio_quality/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -p '*_test.py' -q

supported: signed decimal numbers with up to four fractional digits
valid full-English-month dates from 1900 through 2099; cardinal/ordinal day and common spoken year alternatives
not_automatically_equated: identifier contexts, leading zero numbers, version strings, phone numbers
slash/ISO dates, invalid dates or invalid ordinal suffixes
plain ungrouped years and numbers >=1000 without other context
unsupported precision, currency/unit abbreviations, acronyms and contractions
British cardinal and variants outside supported named-month dates
comparison_event_coordinates: NFKC and explicit-dictionary comparison input, not raw book source offsets

pipeline_fixture_checks.interpretation: Constructed audio and transcriber verify bounded repair scheduling only; no real ASR accuracy or repair efficacy claim

research_status: incomplete: no real boundary positives or independent split, no listener benefit experiment; no verified English voice bank
